beats.text: One server can only take so much traffic. Send it too many requests, and it falls over.
The fix is more servers, with a load balancer in front.
Every request hits the balancer first, and the balancer picks a server.
Inside, it's tiny: a list of servers, and a pointer to whose turn is next.
One, two, three, and back around. That's round robin.
If a server dies, a health check pulls it from the list.
The catch? Now the balancer is the one thing that can't go down.
